correctness.rationale: The source gives a prime defining ideal of codimension two and dimension eight for the canonical two-view conic multiview variety. Exact differentiation shows that on P_gamma only the gamma_5 Jacobian column can survive and on P_delta only the delta_0 column can survive, so the defining Jacobian has rank at most one on each seven-dimensional product stratum. The Jacobian criterion therefore makes both strata singular divisors. A general double-line zero-row point is separately checked to have defining-Jacobian rank two.
